units.source_text: 薰大将屈指计算二女公子所生小公子的五十朝，用心准备庆祝的饼。

en.t: General Kaoru counted on his fingers the fiftieth day after the young lord born to the Second Princess, and carefully prepared celebratory cakes.

units.source_text: 连盛食物的箱笼盘盒都亲自设计。

en.t: He even designed the boxes, baskets, trays, and dishes for serving the food himself.

units.source_text: 不用世间普通的东西，而全用沉香、紫檀、白银、黄金为材料。

en.t: He used none of the ordinary things found in the world, but made everything from aloeswood, red sandalwood, silver, and gold.

units.source_text: 他召集各行各业的许多工匠，叫他们制造。

en.t: He gathered many craftsmen from every trade and had them make the pieces.

units.source_text: 这些工匠便各显身手，争工竞巧，造出种种珍品来。

en.t: The craftsmen each displayed their skill, vying in workmanship and ingenuity, and produced all sorts of rare treasures.

units.source_text: 他自己呢，照例选匂亲王不在家的一天，亲赴二条院访问二女公子。

en.t: As for Kaoru himself, as usual he chose a day when Prince Niou was away and personally went to Nijo-in to visit the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 恐是心理作用所使然：二条院里的人觉得他的模样比前更加神气，增添了高贵的风度。

en.t: Perhaps it was only their imagination, but the people at Nijo-in felt that he looked more splendid than before and had gained an even nobler air.

units.source_text: 二女公子想道：“现在他已娶了二公主，总不会再像从前那样情迷色恋，向我缠绕不休了吧。”

en.t: The Second Princess thought, "Now that he has married the Second Imperial Princess, surely he will no longer be lost in passion as before and keep pestering me."

units.source_text: 便放心地出来和他会面。

en.t: So she came out with an easy mind and met him.

units.source_text: 岂知他的态度依然如故，一见就落下泪来，说道：“我这婚事其实非出心愿，如今更觉世事都不称意，心情越发迷乱了！”

en.t: But his manner was just as it had always been; the moment he saw her, he shed tears and said, "This marriage was never truly what I wished, and now I feel even more that nothing in the world goes as I want, so my heart is more confused than ever."

units.source_text: 便诉说他的愁思。

en.t: Then he poured out his sorrowful thoughts.

units.source_text: 二女公子对他说道：“呀，你这话岂有此理！

en.t: The Second Princess said to him, "Oh, how can you say such unreasonable things!

units.source_text: 被人听见了会泄漏出去呢！”

en.t: If someone hears you, it will get out!"

units.source_text: 但她想道：“此人交了这般好运，毫无快慰之色，而还是不忘记故人，真乃深于情者。”

en.t: But she thought, "Though he has met with such good fortune, he shows no sign of joy and still does not forget the one from the past; he truly is a man of deep feeling."

units.source_text: 她很可怜他，确信此人与众不同。

en.t: She felt great pity for him and became convinced that he was unlike other people.

units.source_text: 又可惜姐姐早死了。

en.t: She also lamented that her elder sister had died so young.

units.source_text: 如果在世，岂不甚好？

en.t: If she were still alive, would that not have been wonderful?

units.source_text: 但她又想：“姐姐即使在世而嫁了他，结果也与我同样命运，两人都成了苦命之身。

en.t: But then she thought, "Even if my sister had lived and married him, in the end she would have shared the same fate as I, and both of us would have become unfortunate women.

units.source_text: 总之，家道衰微的人，决不能参与荣华之列。”

en.t: In short, people from a declining house can never take their place among those who enjoy glory and prosperity."

units.source_text: 如此一想，更觉姐姐决心不嫁而以此长终，真乃高明之见。

en.t: Thinking this, she felt all the more that her sister had shown true wisdom by resolving not to marry and ending her life that way.
